name: What are some popular design trends for modern bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for modern bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern bathroom design trends often emphasize clean lines, minimalist aesthetics, and functional elegance. Popular elements include floating vanities for a spacious feel, large-format tiles for fewer grout lines, and walk-in showers with frameless glass enclosures. Natural materials like wood accents and stone textures are frequently incorporated to add warmth. Smart technology, such as motion-sensor lighting or temperature-controlled showers, is also gaining popularity. Color palettes typically lean towards neutrals like grays, whites, and earthy tones, often accented with black or metallic fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular modern bathroom trends include floating vanities, large tiles, walk-in showers, natural materials, smart technology, and neutral color palettes.
